key_insight: Analytical decision-focused gradients guide evolutionary search for compact synthetic scenario sets, improving two-stage stochastic optimization without requiring direct gradient updates.
engineering_relevance: Smaller, decision-aware scenario sets can reduce computational cost while preserving solution quality in optimization under uncertainty.
method: Derive a closed-form gradient using recourse duality and an adjoint solve of the regularized reduced problem.
Use decision-focused directions—or heuristic backups when duals are unavailable—to guide the evolution strategy’s sampling subspace.
Guarantee expected descent of the smoothed objective for any guiding subspace; inaccurate guidance adds variance.
evidence_signal: Across six problem families, both guided estimators outperform the baseline; decision-focused guidance cuts the mean gap by three-quarters, and on the two most integer-heavy families, reduced sets beat the exact solver’s two-hour incumbent in most runs using one-fifth of the time.
watch_item: The descent guarantee concerns the expected update on a smoothed objective, not every sampled step or global optimality.
paper_title: Boiling Down Uncertainty: Deep Generative Scenario Search with Decision-Guided Evolution Strategies for Two-Stage Stochastic Optimization
